title: Split the Yield, Share the Risk: Pricing, Hedging and Fixed rates in DeFi
abstract: arXiv:2505.22784v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present the first formal treatment of \emph{yield tokenization}, a mechanism that decomposes yield-bearing assets into principal and yield components to facilitate risk transfer and price discovery in decentralized finance (DeFi). We propose a model that characterizes yield token dynamics using stochastic differential equations. We derive a no-arbitrage pricing framework for yield tokens, enabling their use in hedging future yield volatility and managing interest rate risk in decentralized lending pools. Taking DeFi lending as our focus, we show how both borrowers and lenders can use yield tokens to achieve optimal hedging outcomes and mitigate exposure to adversarial interest rate manipulation. Furthermore, we design automated market makers (AMMs) that incorporate a menu of bonding curves to aggregate liquidity from participants with heterogeneous risk preferences. translated_title: 拆分收益，分担风险：去中心化金融（DeFi）中的定价、对冲与固定利率
translated_abstract: 我们首次对收益代币化进行了正式研究，这是一种将生息资产分解为本金和收益两个组成部分的机制，旨在促进去中心化金融（DeFi）中的风险转移和价格发现。我们提出了一个使用随机微分方程来刻画收益代币动态特性的模型。我们推导出收益代币的无套利定价框架，使收益代币能够用于对冲未来收益波动性，并管理去中心化借贷池中的利率风险。以DeFi借贷为研究重点，我们展示了借款人和贷款人如何利用收益代币实现最优对冲效果，并降低面对对抗性利率操纵的风险敞口。此外，我们设计了融合多种联合曲线选项的自动化做市商（AMM），以聚合来自具有异质风险偏好的参与者的流动性，从而形成一种高效且激励相容的机制。
tldr: 该论文首次对DeFi中的收益代币化机制进行形式化研究，建立了基于随机微分方程的无套利定价框架，并设计了聚合异质风险偏好流动性的自动化做市商，使借贷双方能够对冲收益波动和利率操纵风险。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first formal treatment of yield tokenization in DeFi, deriving a no-arbitrage pricing framework for yield tokens and designing AMMs with a menu of bonding curves that enable borrowers and lenders to optimally hedge yield volatility and interest rate manipulation risks.
